# Asset choice, MSX vs NES (Phase 2a) - generated by tools/asset_choice.py; do not edit

For every object and screen of the MSX games: the NES versions found and the one chosen.
REUSE_NES = NES drawing used as is; ADAPT_NES = same object, NES drawing needs work (missing frames,
angles, states); CONVERT_MSX = no NES version, the MSX drawing will be converted in the project style
(phase 5); OWNER_SHIP = player ship replaced by the Salamander (Famicom) ship (owner decision);
NOT_NEEDED = unused, invisible or excluded. Side-by-side images are in the private evidence.

| Nemesis 2 | 153 | 22 | 26 | 1 | 76 | 28 | Gradius II 21, Salamander FC 14, Life Force 7, Gradius 6 | 8 |
| Salamander | 164 | 20 | 31 | 3 | 89 | 21 | Salamander FC 32, Gradius II 9, Life Force 6, Gradius 4 | 13 |
| Nemesis 3 | 192 | 27 | 39 | 1 | 122 | 3 | Gradius II 38, Salamander FC 14, Gradius 10, Life Force 4 | 11 |

## Shared assets: one NES version for the whole game (NES vs NES)

Assets that several MSX games share get one NES version everywhere (phase 3 consistency starts here).
Winner = most detailed version, Gradius II on equal detail; every group was reviewed on side-by-side sheets.

| asset | NES versions compared | chosen | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| player death explosion | g2.player.vic_viper_explosion, gr.effect.vic_viper_explosion, sfc.player.p1_death | sfc.player.p1_death | the explosion of the owner-chosen Salamander FC ship; most detailed (6 drawings) |
| option | g2.player.option, gr.player_weapon.option, lf.player.option, sfc.player.p1_option | sfc.player.p1_option | matches the Salamander FC ship set; most frames (12, two palettes); player 2 keeps sfc.player.p2_option |
| normal shot | g2.weapon.normal_shot, gr.player_weapon.shot, lf.weapon.normal_shot, sfc.weapon.normal_shot | sfc.weapon.normal_shot | most frames, with the vertical-stage drawings the Salamander chapters need |
| laser | g2.weapon.laser, gr.player_weapon.laser, lf.weapon.laser, sfc.weapon.laser | lf.weapon.laser | most detailed: 26 frames covering every laser length (same art as Salamander FC) |
| missile | g2.weapon.missile, gr.player_weapon.missile, lf.weapon.missile, sfc.weapon.missile | sfc.weapon.missile | most frames (12, all directions incl. vertical stages); missile variants adapt from it |
| ripple laser | g2.weapon.ripple, lf.weapon.ripple, sfc.weapon.ripple | sfc.weapon.ripple | most frames (12 vs 3) |
| status bar | g2.hud.status_bar, gr.hud.status_bar, lf.hud.status_bar, sfc.hud.status_bar | g2.hud.status_bar | art direction; the project already uses the Gradius II HUD font |
| font | g2.font.hud, gr.font.hud, gr.font.title_us, lf.font.hud, sfc.font.hud | g2.font.hud | the only complete NES alphabet among them; art direction |
| red capsule | g2.item.capsule, gr.powerup.capsule_red, lf.item.capsule_red, sfc.item.capsule_red | sfc.item.capsule_red | same design in all; Salamander FC / Life Force animate it in more frames |
| blue capsule | gr.powerup.capsule_blue, lf.item.capsule_blue, sfc.item.capsule_blue | sfc.item.capsule_blue | as the red capsule |
| flashing capsule | lf.item.capsule_1up, sfc.item.capsule_1up | sfc.item.capsule_1up | as the red capsule |

| large explosion | g2.effect.explosion_large, gr.effect.explosion_large, lf.effect.explosion_large_blue, sfc.effect.explosion_large | g2.effect.explosion_large | equal detail to Salamander FC (8-9 drawings); art direction |
